'''Thakwaese'''<ref name="UAA">''[[Ultimate Alien Anthology]]''</ref> or '''Thakwaashi'''<ref name="GAW">''[[Galaxy at War]]''</ref> was the native language of the [[Thakwaash]] species. The verbal form consisted of a variety of growls, snorts, and whinnies, while the written form was made up of intricate symbols.<ref name="UAA" />
